Not only did she recite every line perfectly, but she also delivered them with immense passion. Coming off the stage, she couldn't help but smile. "I did it. I really did it," she thought, surprised at how the audition had gone.

④ 심사위원 평가 기준: 심사 기준은 언급 없음
det.tip: 긴장 → 다짐 → 완벽한 무대 → 성공. 두려움 극복 경험이 주제
